site_tagline: Binge Minecraft YouTube series from every point of view, in the order it happened.
notice_text: Couchcrab is a fan-made project. We are not affiliated with Hermitcraft or any creator. Every video plays from YouTube on the creator's own channel.
footer_disclaimer: Couchcrab is an independent fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Hermitcraft, its members, any creator listed here, Mojang or Microsoft. All videos are embedded from YouTube and belong to their creators. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang.
page_fallback_notice: This page is not translated yet. It is shown in English.
series_extras_intro: Livestream VODs from this series, in the order they were uploaded. They also have their own page:
series_description_fallback: This description is not translated yet. It is shown in English.
creator_fan_note: Fan-maintained overview. Not run by or affiliated with {name}.
watch_player_failed: The YouTube player could not be loaded. Use the Watch on YouTube link instead.
watch_demo_placeholder: Demo episode: there is no real YouTube video to play here.
signin_intro: You can watch without an account. Signing in syncs your list and progress.
signin_viewers_text: Sync who you watch and your progress, and suggest edits.
signin_creators_text: Sign in with the Google account of your YouTube channel to claim your profile. We only ask YouTube which channels you own. We don't post anything and we don't keep your Google token.
signin_google_details: What Couchcrab asks YouTube and keeps
signin_google_asks: Asks: read-only access to your YouTube account, used once to list the channels this Google account owns.
signin_google_keeps: Keeps: your Google account id, and the id and name of the channels you claim or send for review.
signin_google_never: Never keeps: your Google token, email address, subscriptions or watch history. Couchcrab can't post, comment or change anything on YouTube.
signin_discord_unavailable: Discord sign-in is not set up on this server. Add DISCORD_CLIENT_ID and DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET to enable it.
signin_google_unavailable: Google sign-in is not set up on this server. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to enable it.
signin_signed_in: You're signed in as {name}. Continuing with the other service links it to this account.
signin_error_not_configured: This sign-in method is not set up on this server.
signin_error_state: Sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
signin_error_provider: We couldn't finish signing in with that service. Please try again.
signin_error_linked_elsewhere: That account is already linked to another Couchcrab account.
signin_error_other_account_linked: Your Couchcrab account is already linked to a different account of that service.

match.countPlural=one: Signed in with Google. This account owns {count} YouTube channel.
match.countPlural=*: Signed in with Google. This account owns {count} YouTube channels.

claim_none: This Google account doesn't own a YouTube channel. Sign in with the Google account of your channel.
claim_desc_needs_review: Not on Couchcrab yet. We'll add it as your channel after a quick review.
claim_desc_claimed_by_other: {name} was already claimed by another account. If that's wrong, send a creator request.
claim_desc_has_other_profile: Matches {name}, but you already claimed another creator profile.
claim_pick_legend: These channels belong to several creators. Which one are you?
claim_after: After claiming you can edit your profile, manage your channels, place your own videos and hide your videos from Couchcrab if you want.
claim_success: You claimed {name}. Your profile now shows the Verified creator badge.
claim_error_expired: Your channel check has expired. Sign in with Google again to check your channels.
claim_error_not_claimable: This profile can't be claimed. It may have been claimed in the meantime.
claim_no_check: To claim your profile, sign in with the Google account of your YouTube channel. The channel check stays valid for 15 minutes.
setting_creator_captions_only: Only show episodes with creator captions
setting_creator_captions_only_help: Applies to every series unless you change it there. Auto-generated captions don't count.
setting_creator_captions_only_series_hel: Hide episodes without CC in this series
settings_saved_locally: Your settings are saved in this browser.
settings_creators_intro: Pick the creators whose POV you want. Series follow this list unless you change it there.
settings_per_series_intro: Each series follows your global list, or uses its own.
settings_series_global_summary: Follows your global list: {count} of {total} creators
settings_series_intro: Choose whose POV you see in this series. Changing a creator here gives the series its own list.
settings_series_global_hint: This series follows your global list now.
setting_text_only_help: Show episodes as a list of titles, without thumbnails
setting_spoiler_default_help: Every series without its own choice hides the titles of unwatched episodes
setting_captions_on: Turn captions on when a video starts
setting_shortcuts_help: Turn off if you use speech input or a screen reader that conflicts
shortcuts_table_caption: Shortcut keys on the watch page
shortcut_title: Show or hide the real title
shortcut_press_key: Press the new key for {action}, or Escape to cancel.
shortcut_invalid_key: Use a letter or a digit. Press Escape to cancel.
shortcut_key_taken: {key} is already used for {action}. Press another key, or Escape to cancel.
upnext_announce: Up next in {seconds} seconds: {next}. Play now or cancel.
upnext_announce_wait: Up next: {next}. Play now or cancel.
account_signed_out_note: Your choices are saved in this browser. Sign in to keep them on all your devices.
manage_dashboard_lead: Everything on Couchcrab is data: creators, channels, series, title rules and site texts are managed here.
manage_creators_lead: Every creator on the site. A claimed creator manages their own bio, avatar and colour.
manage_search_creators: Search creators by name or slug
manage_field_opted_out: Opted out: hide all videos of this creator
manage_hint_slug: Part of the web address. Leave it empty to make it from the name. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
manage_hint_color: Used for the avatar and accents.
manage_hint_avatar: Optional. A link to an image (https). Without one, the initials are shown.
manage_hint_opted_out: Only admins can change this. The creator and all their videos disappear from the public site.
manage_claimed_locked_note: This creator claimed their profile, so the colour, avatar and bio are theirs. Only an admin can change them.
manage_contrast_low: Low (under 3:1): the avatar may blend into the page.
manage_hint_channel: A channel id (UC…), a handle (@name) or a channel URL. Couchcrab looks it up on YouTube so you can check it.
manage_hint_channel_no_key: There is no YouTube API key on this server, so only a channel id (UC…) works and it is not checked.
manage_channel_found: Found on YouTube: {title} ({id}). Is this the right channel?
manage_channel_unchecked: Not checked with YouTube (no API key): {id}. Make sure the id is right.
manage_delete_creator_blocked: This creator has videos ({count}), so it cannot be deleted. Ask an admin to opt the creator out instead.
manage_delete_creator_claimed: This creator claimed their profile. Only an admin can delete it.
manage_confirm_delete_creator_text: The creator and their channels are removed. This is written to the history.
manage_series_lead: Seasons, live series and events. Each series lists the creators who take part.
manage_hint_title: The series name as the creators use it. Not translated.
manage_hint_grouping: How the mixed timeline is grouped: per week, per session (live series) or not at all.
manage_hint_ended: Optional. Leave empty while the series runs.
manage_hint_descriptions: English is required. Other languages are optional; without one the English text is shown.
manage_hint_fallback_en: Optional. When empty, the site shows the English text.
manage_hint_participants: Tick everyone who takes part. Their channels are matched by the title rules of this series.
manage_hint_seed: A number from 1 to 9999. Each number gives a different landscape.
manage_hint_poster_url: A link to an image (https) without text in it.
manage_poster_preview: Preview. The title is real text on top of the art.
manage_extras_explain: An Extras series holds livestreams and side videos. It gets the same creators and poster.
manage_extras_exists: This series has an Extras series:
manage_groups_lead_session: This series is grouped per session. Each session has a start and, once it is over, an end.
manage_groups_lead_week: This series is grouped per week. Weeks are counted automatically; add a manual week only to give it a title or other dates.
manage_groups_lead_none: This series has no grouping, so sessions and weeks are not used on the site.
manage_hint_ends_open: Optional. Leave empty for the current session or week.
manage_confirm_delete_group_text: Its videos stay in the series, without a session or week.
manage_rules_lead: Rules place new uploads of the participating creators into this series. The highest priority is tried first; the first match wins.
manage_no_rules: This series has no title rules yet.
manage_match_contains: Title contains the text (not case sensitive)
manage_hint_pattern: Text or regular expression to find in the video title. At most 200 characters.
manage_hint_rule_channel: Optional. Only apply the rule to uploads of this channel.
manage_hint_target: Livestreams always go to the Extras series.
manage_hint_target_no_extras: This series has no Extras series yet; create one on the Details tab to use it.
manage_hint_priority: From -1000 to 1000. Higher is tried first.
manage_rule_test_summary: Matches: {matches} of the {checked} latest uploads of the participating channels.
manage_confirm_delete_rule_text: Videos it placed stay where they are.
manage_go_apply_rules: Apply the title rules to unsorted videos
manage_rules_page_lead: Rules live per series. Here you can run all of them again over the unsorted videos, for example after adding a rule.
manage_apply_explain: First see what the rules would do. Nothing changes until you confirm.
manage_apply_preview_none: None of the {checked} unsorted videos match a rule. Nothing to apply.
manage_apply_preview_summary: {placed} of the {checked} unsorted videos would be placed:
manage_apply_done: Placed {placed} of {checked} unsorted videos. The history lists each one.
manage_no_rules_anywhere: No series has title rules yet.
manage_unsorted_lead: Uploads no title rule could place. Place them by hand or ignore them.
manage_ignored_lead: Shorts and videos someone ignored. They never appear on the site.
manage_site_lead: The site pages and the short texts that say Couchcrab is unofficial.
manage_texts_lead: These texts show on every public page. If one is empty, the site falls back to English and then to the built-in text, so a disclaimer is always shown.
manage_hint_notice: Shown once to new visitors, followed by a link to the About page. Keep naming who Couchcrab is not affiliated with.
manage_page_lead: Markdown per language. Headings start at level 2: the page title is the only level 1 heading.
manage_hint_page_fallback: Optional. Leave title and text empty to show the English page.
manage_hint_markdown: Markdown: ## heading, **bold**, *italic*, [link](https://…), lists. Other HTML is removed.
manage_preview_not_saved: This is a preview, it is not saved yet.
manage_users_lead: Everyone who signed in. Editors manage content; admins also manage users, pages and the sync.
manage_claims_lead: Creators who signed in with Google and own a channel that is not on Couchcrab yet. Approving adds the channel, verified.
manage_hint_new_creator_name: Only used when adding to a new creator.
manage_claim_approved: Claim approved. The channel is on Couchcrab and verified.
manage_confirm_reject_claim_text: {name} keeps their account; the channel is not added.
manage_sync_lead: Fetch new uploads from YouTube for every channel with sync on, place them with the title rules and refresh old data. A dry run shows the result without saving.
manage_sync_no_key: The sync is off: this server has no YouTube API key (YOUTUBE_API_KEY). The demo data works without one.
manage_sync_running: Syncing, this can take a while…
manage_sync_refresh: Older videos: {checked} checked, {refreshed} refreshed, {restored} back, {removed} removed.
manage_error_invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.
manage_error_invalid_url: Use a full web address that starts with https://.
manage_error_date_order: The end must be after the start.
manage_error_invalid_number: Use a whole number in the allowed range.
manage_error_invalid_regex: This is not a valid regular expression.
manage_error_pattern_too_long: A pattern can be at most 200 characters.
manage_error_no_extras: This series has no Extras series yet.
manage_error_has_extras: This series already has an Extras series.
manage_error_is_extras: An Extras series cannot have its own Extras.
manage_error_has_videos: This still has videos, so it cannot be deleted.
manage_error_claimed_locked: This creator claimed their profile; only an admin can change this.
manage_error_admin_only: Only an admin can change this.
manage_error_last_admin: This is the last admin. Make someone else admin first.
manage_error_invalid_channel: Enter a channel id (UC…), a handle (@name) or a YouTube channel URL.
manage_error_needs_channel_id: Without a YouTube API key only a channel id (UC…) works.
manage_error_channel_taken: This channel is already on Couchcrab.
manage_error_channel_not_found: YouTube has no channel like this.
manage_error_youtube_error: YouTube could not be reached. Try again later.
manage_error_number_taken: This number is already used in this series.
manage_error_group_mismatch: This session or week belongs to another series.
manage_error_claim_other_creator: This user already claimed another creator; add the channel to that creator.
creator_forbidden_title: Only for creators who claimed their profile
creator_forbidden_body: The creator dashboard is for YouTube creators on Couchcrab. Sign in with the Google account that owns your YouTube channel: Couchcrab checks which channels you own and links your creator profile. Channels that are not on Couchcrab yet go to review.
creator_forbidden_link: Go to sign in and claim your profile
creator_dashboard_lead: This is your own creator profile. Changes are shown on Couchcrab right away and kept in the history.
creator_color_hint: Every colour keeps your initials readable on the avatar.
creator_hint_links: Optional. One link per line (https://…), at most 5. Shown on your creator page.

match.countPlural=one: {count} upload isn't in a series yet.
match.countPlural=*: {count} uploads aren't in a series yet.

creator_opt_out_body: Your profile and every video of yours disappear from the site, also from search. The sync stops reading your channels. You can undo this at any time.
creator_opt_out_confirm_title: Hide your profile and all your videos?
creator_opt_out_confirm_body: Nobody sees your profile or your videos on Couchcrab anymore until you show them again here. Viewers keep their own watch history.
creator_opted_out_done: Your profile and videos are hidden from Couchcrab.
creator_hidden_body: Your profile and videos are not shown anywhere on Couchcrab, and the sync skips your channels.
creator_opted_in_done: Your profile and videos are back on Couchcrab.
creator_channels_lead: The YouTube channels on your profile. A verified channel is one you proved you own with Google sign-in.
creator_channel_requested: Not on Couchcrab yet: waiting for review

match.countPlural=one: The channel and its {count} video are hidden from Couchcrab and the sync stops reading it. Nothing is deleted: you can link it again here at any time.
match.countPlural=*: The channel and its {count} videos are hidden from Couchcrab and the sync stops reading it. Nothing is deleted: you can link it again here at any time.

creator_channel_unlinked: The channel was unlinked. Its videos are hidden from Couchcrab.
creator_add_channel_body: Sign in with Google again, with the account that owns the other channel. Couchcrab checks which channels it owns; a channel that is not on Couchcrab yet becomes a request that the team reviews.
creator_videos_lead: Your uploads that aren't in a series yet come first. Place them in a series you take part in (or its Extras), or ignore them. Changes show up right away and are kept in the history.
creator_no_series: You don't take part in a series yet, so there is nothing to place your videos in. Ask the team to add you to a series.
creator_no_videos: No videos of yours are on Couchcrab yet.
manage_creator_self_edited: The creator last edited their own profile on {date}.
creator_channel_relinked: The channel is linked again. Its videos are back on Couchcrab.
manage_channel_unlinked: Unlinked by the creator on {date}. Its videos are hidden from the site and the sync is off.
community_val_by_hand: done by hand, see the note
community_suggest_lead: Tell the reviewers what is wrong. Nothing changes until an editor approves it.
community_type_video_live_vod: It's a livestream VOD (it belongs in Extras)
community_type_series_field: A detail is wrong (title, dates, description…)
community_no_groups_here: This series has no sessions or weeks.
community_no_extras_here: This series has no Extras series, so this choice isn't available.
community_captions_legend: Does this video have captions made by the creator?
community_field_creator_name: Name of the creator, if not on Couchcrab yet
community_note_hint: For example where you saw the session number. At most {max} characters.
community_sent_text: An editor will look at it. You can follow it on My suggestions.
community_back_to_item: Back to the page you came from
community_not_found_title: Nothing to suggest an edit for
community_not_found: This item can't be found or isn't public. Open “Suggest an edit” from a video, series or creator page.
community_something_wrong_text: A video in the wrong series or session, a missing creator, a wrong CC badge?
community_error_no_change: That is already the current value.
community_error_rate_limited: You've sent a lot today. Try again tomorrow.
community_error_invalid_email: Enter an email address like name@example.org.
community_error_target_missing: This item no longer exists or isn't public.
community_error_use_claims: This request is handled on the Claims page.
community_error_apply_failed: The change could not be applied.
community_error_not_revertible: This kind of change can't be reverted here.
community_error_from_youtube: This data comes from YouTube; the sync keeps it up to date.
community_error_conflict: It changed again since. Revert the newer change first, or change it by hand.
community_error_failed: The revert could not be applied.
community_requests_lead: Are you a creator whose videos are on Couchcrab? Ask for a correction, or for removal of your videos. Reviewers always look at creator requests first.
community_requests_claim_tip: Tip: if you sign in with the Google account of your channel, you can claim your profile and change it yourself.
community_requests_signed_in: You're signed in as {name}. You'll find the answer on My suggestions.
community_requests_signed_out: You don't need an account. Leave an email address so a reviewer can answer you.
community_request_creator: Your creator profile on Couchcrab, if there is one
community_request_channel: Your YouTube channel (link or id, optional)
community_request_email_hint: Only reviewers see it. It's used only to answer this request.
community_request_sent: Thanks, your request was sent. Reviewers look at creator requests first.
community_me_lead: Everything you suggested, and what reviewers said about it.
community_me_empty: You haven't suggested anything yet. Use “Suggest an edit” on a video, series or creator page.
community_me_answer_hint: To answer a question, send a new suggestion with your answer in the note.
community_me_trust_explain: Trust is the number of approved suggestions minus the rejected ones.
community_review_lead: Open suggestions and creator requests. Creator requests are always on top. Approving applies the change and writes it to the history.
community_review_by_hand: Approving marks it as done. Make the change by hand.
community_review_claim: A channel claim from Google sign-in. Handle it on the Claims page.
community_review_missing: The item no longer exists. You can reject this suggestion.
community_history_lead: Every change by a person, a title rule or the sync. Editors can revert changes to content, admins can revert everything that can be reverted.
community_revert_confirm_text: This writes the Before state back through the management tool and adds a new entry to the history.
community_reverted: Reverted. The history has a new entry.
community_public_history_lead: Changes to this series, its sessions and its episodes. People who suggested a change stay anonymous.
community_promote_explain: Viewers with a trust of {threshold} or more are marked “Suggest promoting to editor”. Trust is approved minus rejected suggestions. Promotion stays manual.
manage_error_channel_unlinked: The creator unlinked this channel. An admin can restore it, which turns the sync on again.
manage_channel_sync_unlinked_hint: Unlinked by the creator: the sync stays off until an admin restores the channel.
search_empty_lead: Type a series title, a creator's name or an episode title in the search field at the top of the page. Upper case and accents don't matter.
search_tip_spelling: Check the spelling, or use fewer or shorter words.
search_tip_spoiler: In spoiler-free series, episode titles are not searched. Search for the series or the creator instead.
search_capped: Showing the first {count}. Add a word to narrow the search.
community_page_my_lead: See what you suggested and what the reviewers answered.
community_page_review_lead: Suggestions and creator requests that wait for a reviewer.
community_page_signin: Sign in to suggest an edit
community_page_signin_lead: Anyone with an account can suggest an edit. Nothing changes until a reviewer approves it.
community_recent_lead: Changes to series, sessions, title rules and episodes across Couchcrab. People who suggested a change stay anonymous.
together_intro: Every POV of the same livestream side by side, on one clock. The streams are lined up by the moment each one started live. One POV plays sound at a time.
together_dropped: Some videos could not join, because they are not public livestreams with a known start: {count}
together_empty: There is nothing to watch together here yet. Open a series with livestreams and choose Watch together at a session or a stream.
together_waiting: Waiting until every POV has loaded
together_copy_failed: The link could not be copied. Copy it from the address bar instead.
together_demo: Demo POV: there is no real YouTube video here. Position:
together_shift_hint: Shift: a POV that runs ahead or behind can be moved in seconds. A positive number plays it later. The shift is part of the copied link.
together_add_none: No other POVs of this stream.
together_full: At most {max} POVs at once. Remove one to add another.
together_bandwidth: Every POV is its own YouTube player. On a slow connection, two or three work best.
together_with_others: Watch together with the other POVs: {count}
